Location: US/Europe
Description:

Seeking Ordinary Seaman, Wiper, Welder, and Fitter for a passenger ship with a GRT of 15000 or above. A minimum of 18 months of sailing experience is required, with no more than a 7-month gap. Candidates with relevant experience in shipyards, repair facilities, or onboard vessels are eligible for Welder and Fitter positions. Location:
Description:

Experienced Electronic Engineers and Electricians are sought for opportunities aboard cruise ships. The Electronic Engineer role involves maintaining radar, ECDIS, GPS, AIS, VDR, and bridge electronics, as well as communication systems and safety-management interfaces, with a salary range of USD 10,900-12,900 per month. The Electrician position focuses on maintaining lighting and repairing electrical equipment across various ship areas, earning USD 4,400 per month. Both positions require a safety-first mindset and participation in emergency drills, with a contract duration of 3 months on and 3 months off.



Apply to this job
